title: The second project's run of one item on the plugin's sprint files each retrospective finding about the tooling as a kb bug or story under the epic, and a report records the run
goal: After a git project other than the kb has installed the plugin, written its backlog.json and run one item from claim to dispatch, land and close on the plugin's sprint skill with the operator present, each finding of its retrospective about the tooling is a kb bug or story under EP-4fawjprq, with a repro from that run, and its title ends in the words second-project run in parentheses (a run with no findings files one story saying so in the same form); kb/_self/reports/plugin-sprint-second-project.md records the run (the project's backlog.json keys, the install steps, the item, each finding's id), so done has a commit that changes a file besides item files
